note: Fivestar is a Voting API-backed star rating system. It provides a 'fivestar' field type (FivestarItem), widgets fivestar_stars/fivestar_select, formatters fivestar_stars/fivestar_percentage/fivestar_rating, a '#type => fivestar' Form element, and a hook-driven star-skin registry (fivestar.widget_manager). Services: fivestar.vote_manager, fivestar.vote_result_manager, fivestar.widget_manager. One permission: 'rate content'. It has NO working central admin page (info.yml's configure: fivestar.admin_overview route is not registered) so all config is per field: field storage settings.vote_type (default 'vote'), field instance settings (stars, allow_clear/revote/ownvote, rated_while, voting target), and the display formatter/widget settings (fivestar_widget skin). Medium/hard cases are grounded in real field + entity_view_display config on the Article content type.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal contrib module Fivestar, what is the machine name of the field type it provides, and what widgets and formatters can I use to display it?
evals.expected_output: Fivestar provides a field type with id 'fivestar' (FivestarItem). Widgets: fivestar_stars (interactive stars) and fivestar_select (a select list). Formatters: fivestar_stars (interactive/average stars), fivestar_percentage (e.g. 92), fivestar_rating (e.g. 4.2/5).

evals.prompt: How does the Fivestar module actually store ratings on a Drupal 11 site, and what module does it depend on for that?
evals.expected_output: Fivestar depends on the Voting API (votingapi) module. Each time a fivestar field is saved it records a votingapi 'vote' entity of the field storage's configured vote_type (default 'vote'); the rating is stored 0-100 internally. Aggregated results come from Voting API.

evals.prompt: I want to programmatically cast a Fivestar rating on an entity from custom Drupal code. Which service and method should I call?
evals.expected_output: Use the fivestar.vote_manager service (VoteManagerInterface) and call addVote($entity, $rating, $vote_type = 'vote', $uid = NULL); the rating is capped at 100. Aggregated results can be read via fivestar.vote_result_manager.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a Fivestar rating field named field_fs_known. Inspect its live field configuration and tell me how many stars it is configured to show.
evals.expected_output: 7 stars. In field.field.node.article.field_fs_known the settings.stars value is 7.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type displays a Fivestar field field_fs_skin using the interactive stars formatter. Inspect the live default view display and tell me which Fivestar star skin (widget) is configured for that field.
evals.expected_output: The 'hearts' skin. In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_fs_skin component (formatter fivestar_stars) has settings.fivestar_widget = hearts.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, add a Fivestar rating field with machine name field_fs_task to the Article content type (field type 'fivestar', 5 stars, vote type 'vote'). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A field storage of type 'fivestar' named field_fs_task on the node entity type, plus a field instance on the article bundle (e.g. via FieldStorageConfig::create + FieldConfig::create, or the Manage fields UI).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Article content type has a Fivestar field named field_fs_display. Its default view display currently shows the field with the percentage formatter. Change the default display so field_fs_display uses the Fivestar 'Rating (i.e. 4.2/5)' formatter (fivestar_rating) instead. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_fs_display component type is set to fivestar_rating (e.g. setComponent('field_fs_display', ['type' => 'fivestar_rating']) on the default view display, or pick 'Rating (i.e. 4.2/5)' in Manage display).
